scope: One private Smarter Justice professional account, firm, seat, billing, and profile-management layer distributing approved specialty records to independent legal micro-portals.
rules: One private Smarter Justice professional account across qualifying legal portals.
Attorneys may claim an existing record or create a private profile from scratch; owner-assisted entry is supported.
One firm organization account manages offices, professional seats, central billing, and permissions.
Public specialty profiles belong on focused legal micro-portals, not in a duplicate Smarter Justice directory.
A central profile revision must be complete, submitted, reviewed, and independently verified before any portal may publish it.
Portal-assignment approval is valid only for the exact central source revision approved by the owner.
Payment never buys verification, specialty evidence, portal approval, publication, ranking, inquiries, clients, or outcomes.
Portal exports are versioned, read-only, nonconfidential, idempotent, and contain no user matters, secrets, credentials, payment data, or automatic write instructions.
Existing public profiles are claimed from the focused portal; account creation, verification and management execute centrally in Smarter Justice.
The historical v1.7.43 complimentary pilot did not create paid, verification, eligibility, publication, ranking, or endorsement status and is no longer an active launch model.
Portal-specific profile revisions are independent from the shared central profile revision and use expected-revision writes.
Portal-specific approval is valid only for the exact portal revision and exact current central source revision.
A later central shared-profile change withholds the previously approved portal-specific projection until re-reviewed.
Portal acceptance records do not prove D4 staging or D5 production without authentic external evidence.
